scope: Research taxonomy of robotic solution-space structure; not a standardized ontology or an implementation of 60 physical evaluators.
notation: F(T): feasible set in declared candidate domain. G(p): object-relative feasible grasps. Γ: path family. V: declared structural descriptor. μ: specified measure. All results are relative to scope, models and evidence. A sampled negative result is not a continuous infeasibility proof.

edge_semantics.requires: Computational/evidence dependency; directed acyclic graph. Not sufficient or causal alone.
edge_semantics.specializes: Narrower or scoped variant of a concept. Not an inference rule.
edge_semantics.diagnostic_related: Potential follow-up query; may be cyclic; no logical implication or causality asserted.

concepts.name: Shared-Grasp Compatibility
concepts.definition: Common object-relative grasp modes feasible at both specified object poses.
concepts.formalization: G(ps) ∩ G(pg); compatible iff nonempty.
concepts.evaluator: Intersect candidate identities after endpoint grasp, IK and collision checks.
concepts.required_inputs: Common grasp universe, two object poses, robot/base and obstacles.
concepts.limitations: Necessary for fixed-grasp transfer; not sufficient for a path. Empty sampled intersection is not a continuous certificate.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Grasp–Task Compatibility
concepts.definition: Grasps admitting a complete task execution under stated attachment and physical constraints.
concepts.formalization: G_task={g: ∃z∈F(T), attachment(z)=g throughout required stages}.
concepts.evaluator: Filter candidate grasps by complete transfer and task wrench feasibility if dynamics are in scope.
concepts.required_inputs: Task, attachment family, permitted mode changes, geometry and dynamic constraints.
concepts.limitations: If dynamics are excluded report geometric compatibility only. Not endpoint graspability.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Grasp–IK Compatibility
concepts.definition: Projection of the feasible grasp/configuration relation onto grasp space at a given object pose or pose family.
concepts.formalization: G(p)={g: ∃q, FK(q)=p·g, q∈Qvalid(p,g)}.
concepts.evaluator: Sample grasps; enumerate or sample IK branches and filter collisions and limits.
concepts.required_inputs: Object poses, grasp transforms, robot, joint limits, environment.
concepts.limitations: A single IK witness is local evidence; it does not establish path feasibility or exhaustive coverage.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Skill Compatibility
concepts.definition: Whether the reachable outputs of one skill intersect the admissible inputs of a subsequent skill consistently.
concepts.formalization: Post(S1) ∩ Pre(S2) ≠ ∅ in common state and variable space.
concepts.evaluator: Compute reachable postconditions and feasible preconditions; test shared assignments.
concepts.required_inputs: Skill models, start sets, boundary states, geometric and resource constraints.
concepts.limitations: Symbolic predicate agreement alone is insufficient if continuous parameters differ.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Base–Task Compatibility
concepts.definition: Common stationary base placements supporting all specified task stages.
concepts.formalization: B_task=∩_i B_i; B_i={b: stage i has a feasible witness at b}.
concepts.evaluator: Intersect inverse reachability sets; verify collision and path constraints.
concepts.required_inputs: Base domain, stage targets, robot, obstacles, resolution.
concepts.limitations: Separate stage witnesses may be mutually incompatible; moving-base tasks need different mode assumptions.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Bimanual Grasp Compatibility
concepts.definition: Grasp pairs allowing both arms to simultaneously realize a common rigid-object pose under joint and collision constraints.
concepts.formalization: {(gL,gR): ∃qL,qR,p, FK_L(qL)=p·gL, FK_R(qR)=p·gR, all constraints hold}.
concepts.evaluator: Pair grasps, solve coupled IK, check inter-arm and object collision.
concepts.required_inputs: Both robots, object pose, grasp pairs, limits and obstacles.
concepts.limitations: Static simultaneous feasibility is not a transport or load-sharing guarantee.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Configuration-Space Connectivity
concepts.definition: Existence of a continuous path between specified configurations in valid configuration space.
concepts.evaluator: Roadmap or continuous search, verified edges, certified methods for negative claims.
concepts.required_inputs: Configuration space, collision model, endpoints and constraints.
concepts.limitations: Path-connectedness is relevant; finite roadmap disconnection does not prove continuous disconnection.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Grasp Connectivity
concepts.definition: Set of fixed rigid grasps for which a valid transfer path connects endpoint state sets.
concepts.formalization: {g: ∃γ⊂Qfree(g), γ connects admissible start and goal sets}.
concepts.evaluator: Search inside each candidate transfer mode with attachment retained.
concepts.required_inputs: Endpoint grasp sets, robot, object, transfer mode geometry.
concepts.limitations: Endpoint compatibility alone is insufficient; prescribed object paths use B05.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: IK Branch Connectivity
concepts.definition: Existence of a continuous valid joint-space lift of a prescribed end-effector path.
concepts.formalization: ∃ continuous q(s): FK(q(s))=T(s), q(s)∈Qvalid(s).
concepts.evaluator: Generate waypoint IK candidates, verify connecting lifts, search layered graph.
concepts.required_inputs: Cartesian path, IK solver, tolerances, limits, collisions.
concepts.limitations: IK family labels need not be globally invariant; adjacent endpoint proximity is not an edge certificate.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Object-Pose Connectivity
concepts.definition: Reachability between object poses under a declared set of manipulation modes.
concepts.formalization: ∃ hybrid execution ξ whose object projection connects ps and pg.
concepts.evaluator: Search object/grasp/mode graph with consistent robot witnesses.
concepts.required_inputs: Object domain, allowed modes, robot, support and collision models.
concepts.limitations: Object-only geometric paths need a consistent robot realization.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Grasp–IK Trajectory Connectivity
concepts.definition: Continuous feasible grasp and IK realization along a prescribed object path, with only explicitly permitted mode changes.
concepts.formalization: ∃g,q(s): FK(q(s))=p(s)·g, all constraints; g constant within transfer segments.
concepts.evaluator: Construct layered grasp–IK graph; verify edges; DP for paths or allowed release cost.
concepts.required_inputs: Object path, grasp candidates, IK branches, transition rules.
concepts.limitations: Report fixed-grasp versus release-allowed scope; finite graph is approximate. This is a HiCoD synthesis of cited foundations.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Multi-modal Connectivity
concepts.definition: Connectivity using feasible within-mode paths and admissible transitions between modes.
concepts.formalization: ∃m0…mk, γi⊂F_mi and valid connecting transitions.
concepts.evaluator: Build/search hybrid mode graph; validate within-mode and transition witnesses.
concepts.required_inputs: Mode manifolds, boundary relations, start and goal sets.
concepts.limitations: A symbolic mode edge without a valid boundary witness can be optimistic.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Homotopy Diversity
concepts.definition: Multiplicity of distinct endpoint-fixed homotopy classes of feasible paths.
concepts.formalization: γ1∼γ2 iff an endpoint-fixed continuous deformation remains in Qfree; count represented classes.
concepts.evaluator: Topology-aware signatures or certificates and alternative path sampling.
concepts.required_inputs: Free space, endpoints, path family, equivalence relation.
concepts.limitations: Homology may merge homotopy classes; observed count is only a lower bound with sound classification.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Connectivity Redundancy
concepts.definition: Multiplicity of independent connections between endpoints in a specified graph.
concepts.formalization: κ_e(s,t)=max number of edge-disjoint paths=min unit-capacity edge cut.
concepts.evaluator: Compute max flow/min cut or vertex-disjoint paths as declared.
concepts.required_inputs: Graph, endpoints, capacity and independence criterion.
concepts.limitations: Graph redundancy does not guarantee robustness to correlated physical failures.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Regrasp Feasibility
concepts.definition: Existence of a task-completing execution containing at least one valid attachment change.
concepts.formalization: ∃ feasible hybrid path with ≥1 validated grasp switch.
concepts.evaluator: Search regrasp graph with support, transit and transfer checks.
concepts.required_inputs: Grasp modes, poses, support surfaces and switch rules.
concepts.limitations: A feasible regrasp does not prove a regrasp is necessary.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Intermediate-Pose Bridging
concepts.definition: Intermediate poses allowing feasible incoming transfer, grasp change and outgoing transfer.
concepts.formalization: M={p: ∃gin,gout, transfer(ps,p,gin)∧switch(p,gin,gout)∧transfer(p,pg,gout)}.
concepts.evaluator: Sample stable placements; prefilter shared grasps then verify both transfers and switch.
concepts.required_inputs: Endpoint poses, placement domain, support and grasp constraints.
concepts.limitations: Endpoint intersections alone do not verify motion or stable placement.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Handover Feasibility
concepts.definition: Existence of a coordinated transfer of ownership between arms with valid acquisition and release.
concepts.formalization: ∃ common state x and feasible receive/release motions with permitted support.
concepts.evaluator: Search handover poses and grasp pairs, solve coupled IK, verify release and approach.
concepts.required_inputs: Arms, grasp pairs, support/force assumptions, handover region.
concepts.limitations: Simultaneous static IK is necessary but does not guarantee safe transfer.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Mode Transition Feasibility
concepts.definition: Existence of a realizable boundary-state transition between two manipulation modes.
concepts.formalization: T_mn={(x,y): x∈F_m, y∈F_n, (x,y)∈R_mn}; nonempty on reachable subsets.
concepts.evaluator: Check guards, reset relations, approach, collisions and support at sampled boundaries.
concepts.required_inputs: Mode definitions, boundary states and transition rules.
concepts.limitations: Intersection of mode manifolds need not imply a physically realizable switch.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Minimum Mode-Switch Cost
concepts.definition: Minimum sum of assigned transition costs among task-completing executions.
concepts.formalization: min_π Σ_{e∈π}w(e); unit switch weights count switches.
concepts.evaluator: Shortest path/DP on validated mode graph, record optimum within graph.
concepts.required_inputs: Mode graph, weights, endpoints.
concepts.limitations: Graph optimum is not continuous global optimum; absence requires appropriate certificate.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Transition Region Availability
concepts.definition: Measure or sampled fraction of reachable boundary states admitting a specified mode transition.
concepts.formalization: μ_T(T_mn∩reachable region), on declared transition coordinates.
concepts.evaluator: Sample intrinsic transition domain and estimate feasible fraction/support.
concepts.required_inputs: Transition parameterization, sampling measure and domain.
concepts.limitations: Lower-dimensional boundaries can have zero ambient measure; report intrinsic measure.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Geometric Bottleneck
concepts.definition: Localized geometric feature restricting the family of feasible routes, supported by structural or counterfactual evidence.
concepts.formalization: Compare connectivity/capacity of F before and after a declared regional perturbation.
concepts.evaluator: Locate cuts/low-clearance regions and evaluate controlled geometry interventions.
concepts.required_inputs: Path family, geometry, region and allowed interventions.
concepts.limitations: One colliding trajectory is not sufficient to establish a global bottleneck.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Narrow Passage
concepts.definition: Restrictive connecting free-space region with small measure or visibility relative to nearby regions under a declared metric.
concepts.formalization: Proxy: low-measure separator or low expansiveness across a partition of Qfree.
concepts.evaluator: Estimate visibility/expansiveness and roadmap connectivity with adaptive sampling.
concepts.required_inputs: Free space, sampling measure, metric, local planner.
concepts.limitations: No universal threshold; workspace aperture is not C-space passage width.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Connectivity Bottleneck
concepts.definition: A cut or stage transition limiting the capacity of task paths in a specified graph.
concepts.formalization: min_{S:s∈S,t∉S} Σ_{e∈δ+(S)}cap(e).
concepts.evaluator: Minimum cut or stagewise edge counts with path-conditioned analysis.
concepts.required_inputs: Task graph, capacities and endpoint sets.
concepts.limitations: Capacities and graph approximation determine interpretation; sampled zero cut is not a global proof.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Singularity Bottleneck
concepts.definition: Task-required motion restricted across candidate paths by low directional velocity margin or poor Jacobian rank.
concepts.formalization: sup_{γ∈Γ} inf_s σ_min(J_task(q(s))) as a scaled proxy.
concepts.evaluator: Evaluate task velocity feasibility over path family; localize restricted directions.
concepts.required_inputs: Jacobian, task direction, scaling, velocity bounds, path family.
concepts.limitations: A small singular value on one path is L3; full rank is not a guarantee of execution.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Clearance Bottleneck
concepts.definition: The best attainable minimum clearance across a stated candidate path family.
concepts.formalization: sup_{γ∈Γ} inf_s d(γ(s),obstacles).
concepts.evaluator: Signed-distance checks and widest-path search; identify limiting geometry.
concepts.required_inputs: Path family, obstacle and robot geometry, distance metric.
concepts.limitations: Clearance of one trajectory is local; sampled best clearance is only a scoped estimate.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Critical Constraint
concepts.definition: Constraint whose controlled diagnostic removal or permitted parameter change alters a declared structural metric or feasibility.
concepts.formalization: Δ_i=V(F(C\{ci}))−V(F(C)).
concepts.evaluator: Controlled re-solving or probing with a comparable domain and budget.
concepts.required_inputs: Constraint set, intervention rules, descriptor, solver oracle.
concepts.limitations: Interactions matter; diagnostic removal never authorizes violating safety constraints.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Constraint Conflict
concepts.definition: Infeasible constraint subset; inclusion-minimal if every proper subset is feasible.
concepts.formalization: C'⊆C, F(C')=∅; minimal if all proper subsets feasible.
concepts.evaluator: Extract conflicts using sound feasibility/infeasibility oracle semantics.
concepts.required_inputs: Constraints, variables, tolerances, certificate requirements.
concepts.limitations: Inclusion-minimal is not minimum cardinality; local solver failure is not a proof.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Grasp–Motion Dependency
concepts.definition: Dependence of the feasible downstream motion family on the upstream grasp selection.
concepts.formalization: M(g)={τ:(g,τ)∈F(T)}; compare conditional fibers across g.
concepts.evaluator: Fix each grasp, explore valid transfers, compare paths or structural measures.
concepts.required_inputs: Grasp family, motion domain, task constraints.
concepts.limitations: Equalize exploration budget and parameterization; observed association need not be causal.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Cross-Stage Dependency
concepts.definition: Change in downstream feasible sets conditional on different admissible upstream choices.
concepts.formalization: F_future(x)={z_future:(x,z_future) satisfies remaining constraints}.
concepts.evaluator: Condition on different boundary states and probe suffix feasibility.
concepts.required_inputs: Task skeleton, boundary state domain, remaining constraints.
concepts.limitations: Compare controlled choices; distinguish correlation from causal intervention.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Object Blocking Dependency
concepts.definition: A directed dependency induced when an object occupies a required placement or motion region of another object in a stated model.
concepts.formalization: i→j if j blocks required placement/action of i in that model.
concepts.evaluator: Test goal overlap or swept-volume blocking across allowed candidates.
concepts.required_inputs: Object poses, geometries, action model and target arrangements.
concepts.limitations: Goal-overlap dependencies assume a specific rearrangement model; path-dependent blocking may be conditional.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Task Ordering Dependency
concepts.definition: Precedence implied by constraints across all feasible executions in the declared task model.
concepts.formalization: i≺j iff every feasible execution in scope orders i before j (nonempty feasible family).
concepts.evaluator: Derive mandatory precedences or test alternative sequences with witnesses.
concepts.required_inputs: Actions, temporal/precondition constraints, blocking model.
concepts.limitations: An observed order is not mandatory; conditional precedences need explicit guards.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Deadlock / Cyclic Dependency
concepts.definition: Cycle in strict precedence relations, or a reachable non-goal state with no enabled continuation under a stated model.
concepts.formalization: Cycle in fixed precedence graph; behavioral deadlock if no admissible progress action.
concepts.evaluator: Strongly connected components and state-space continuation checks.
concepts.required_inputs: Precedence model, modes, buffer availability, enabled actions.
concepts.limitations: A dependency cycle can be resolved by buffers; not necessarily global infeasibility.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Future Feasibility Preservation
concepts.definition: Whether an intermediate state lies in the goal-reachable set for remaining stages.
concepts.formalization: K_i={x: ∃ admissible continuation from x to goal}; require x∈K_i.
concepts.evaluator: Backward graph reachability or controllable-set analysis.
concepts.required_inputs: Remaining stages, goal, transition model and constraints.
concepts.limitations: Robust versions need explicit control/disturbance quantifier order.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Variable Coupling
concepts.definition: Nonseparability of feasibility or cost over declared decision-variable blocks.
concepts.formalization: F_AB ≠ proj_A(F_AB)×proj_B(F_AB), or objective nonadditivity.
concepts.evaluator: Inspect factor scopes, conditional feasible fibers or cross-derivative proxies.
concepts.required_inputs: Variable partition, constraints, objective and domains.
concepts.limitations: Shared factors show potential coupling, not its quantitative strength; Hessian is local.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Constraint Coupling
concepts.definition: Interaction between constraints through shared variables and joint feasible relations.
concepts.formalization: Compare F(C1∪C2) with individual feasible sets and joint satisfiability.
concepts.evaluator: Build constraint incidence graph, test joint feasibility and conflicts.
concepts.required_inputs: Constraint scopes, variable domains, feasibility oracle.
concepts.limitations: Coupling may occur without conflict; structural incidence alone does not quantify strength.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Bimanual Kinematic Coupling
concepts.definition: Closed-chain constraint that both arms realize the same rigid-object transform.
concepts.formalization: FK_L(qL)·gL⁻¹=FK_R(qR)·gR⁻¹=p within tolerance.
concepts.evaluator: Coupled IK, relative pose residuals and joint path checks.
concepts.required_inputs: Robot models, object-relative grasps, limits and collisions.
concepts.limitations: Independent-arm feasibility is insufficient; assumes rigid cooperative attachment.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Task Decomposability
concepts.definition: Whether a partition into subproblems with shared separators preserves feasibility and, if requested, optimality.
concepts.formalization: With separator s, F(s)=∏_k F_k(s); cost separability additionally needed for independent optimality.
concepts.evaluator: Analyze constraint graph separators; verify consistent assignments and objective.
concepts.required_inputs: Factor graph, proposed partition, separator and objective.
concepts.limitations: Approximate decomposition may sacrifice optimality or completeness; declare preserved properties.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Conditional Independence
concepts.definition: After fixing separator variables, feasible assignments in remaining blocks factorize.
concepts.formalization: F(A,B|s)=F(A|s)×F(B|s) for relevant s.
concepts.evaluator: Inspect factor scopes after conditioning; test feasible relation factorization.
concepts.required_inputs: Constraint network, variable blocks, separator assignments.
concepts.limitations: This is deterministic feasibility independence, not automatically statistical independence.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Grasp Sensitivity
concepts.definition: Change in task-level descriptor due to admissible variation of grasp variables.
concepts.formalization: Δ_gV=[V(g⊕δ)−V(g)]/||δ||_W, or derivative when smooth.
concepts.evaluator: Controlled grasp perturbations or discrete comparisons with equal budgets.
concepts.required_inputs: Grasp parameterization, perturbation metric and task descriptor.
concepts.limitations: For discrete grasps use finite contrasts; account for search noise.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Object-Pose Sensitivity
concepts.definition: Variation of a task descriptor under permitted object-pose changes.
concepts.formalization: Δ_pV=[V(p⊕δ)−V(p)]/||δ||_W in declared SE(3) coordinates.
concepts.evaluator: Perturb normalized translation/rotation coordinates, recompute descriptor.
concepts.required_inputs: Pose domain, units, task and perturbation bounds.
concepts.limitations: Do not change mandatory task poses; specify translation/rotation normalization.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Base-Pose Sensitivity
concepts.definition: Variation of task feasibility or quality induced by changes in robot base pose.
concepts.evaluator: Probe base placements using inverse reachability and task checks.
concepts.required_inputs: Base pose domain, task, descriptor, allowable base movement.
concepts.limitations: Inverse reachability alone cannot verify full task or base navigation.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Trajectory Sensitivity
concepts.definition: Variation of structural task descriptor under admissible changes in trajectory parameters.
concepts.formalization: ∇_aV(τ(a)) or controlled finite differences.
concepts.evaluator: Differentiate validated surrogate or probe spline parameters within deformation budget.
concepts.required_inputs: Trajectory parameterization, metric, fixed endpoints and budget.
concepts.limitations: Surrogate gradients need physical verification; discrete metrics may be nonsmooth.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Constraint Sensitivity
concepts.definition: Variation of optimal value or feasible-space descriptor with constraint parameters.
concepts.formalization: dV*/dθ where differentiable; finite perturbation otherwise.
concepts.evaluator: Parametric optimization, valid dual sensitivity or controlled re-solving.
concepts.required_inputs: Constraint parameterization, metric, allowed perturbations.
concepts.limitations: Dual interpretations require regularity; feasibility may change discontinuously.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Feasibility Robustness
concepts.definition: Persistence of feasibility under declared uncertainty, distinguishing fixed-plan from replan feasibility.
concepts.formalization: Pδ[valid(z,δ)] versus Pδ[∃z valid(z,δ)]; or worst-case versions.
concepts.evaluator: Sample uncertainty or compute robust sets with declared quantifiers.
concepts.required_inputs: Perturbation distribution/set, model, solution family.
concepts.limitations: Finite Monte Carlo is estimation, not guarantee; uncertainty assumptions are essential.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Grasp Robustness
concepts.definition: Probability or bounded tolerance of grasp success under pose/contact/friction disturbances; L4 aggregates a family or task.
concepts.formalization: Pδ[grasp_success(g,δ)] or worst-case wrench margin across task/grasps.
concepts.evaluator: Perturb contact models, evaluate force/wrench feasibility or physical trials.
concepts.required_inputs: Grasp family, contact model, uncertainty and success condition.
concepts.limitations: A single grasp's robustness score is L3 unless used to describe a family or task.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Connectivity Robustness
concepts.definition: Persistence of connectivity as scene, robot or task parameters vary.
concepts.formalization: Pδ[connected(Fδ)] versus ∃γ∀δ valid(γ,δ).
concepts.evaluator: Rebuild graphs under perturbations and independently evaluate fixed-path robustness.
concepts.required_inputs: Graph protocol, uncertainty, endpoints, constraints.
concepts.limitations: ∀δ∃γ is weaker than ∃γ∀δ; sampled topology is resolution dependent.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Solution-Space Volume
concepts.definition: Measure of feasible solutions relative to an explicitly declared candidate domain and measure.
concepts.formalization: μ(F) or μ(F)/μ(Z) with specified base/intrinsic measure.
concepts.evaluator: Uniform or importance sampling; estimate feasible fraction and uncertainty.
concepts.required_inputs: Domain, measure, feasibility predicate and sample protocol.
concepts.limitations: Equality-constrained sets may have zero ambient volume; parameterization matters.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Solution Diversity
concepts.definition: Variety of feasible solutions measured by a declared distance, mode or equivalence relation.
concepts.formalization: Count represented classes or ε-separated verified witnesses.
concepts.evaluator: Cluster verified candidates or compute mode/topology signatures.
concepts.required_inputs: Feasible candidates, metric/equivalence and thresholds.
concepts.limitations: No universal diversity metric; different paths can share failure modes.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Failure Tolerance
concepts.definition: Retention of task feasibility after specified components, modes or capabilities fail.
concepts.formalization: max k such that all allowed failure sets of size ≤k preserve a goal path, or probability under failure model.
concepts.evaluator: Remove modeled failures and recompute verified reachability.
concepts.required_inputs: Failure model, graph, endpoints and failure correlations.
concepts.limitations: Disjoint graph paths may share physical risks; modeled failure sets matter.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Recoverability
concepts.definition: Existence of a permitted safe continuation from a failed or perturbed state to the original goal.
concepts.formalization: x_fail∈backward reachable goal set under permitted controls and safety bounds.
concepts.evaluator: Backward search/reachability with verified recovery witness.
concepts.required_inputs: Failure state, goal, recovery actions, hard safety constraints.
concepts.limitations: Simulator reset need not be physically available; real state/model validity matter.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Minimum Constraint Removal
concepts.definition: Minimum-cost set of constraints whose diagnostic removal admits a valid path.
concepts.formalization: min_{D⊆C}cost(D) s.t. F(C\D)≠∅; original MCR counts removals.
concepts.evaluator: Labeled roadmap or constrained search with witness and bound.
concepts.required_inputs: Constraint labels, costs, endpoints and geometry.
concepts.limitations: Diagnostic removal is not authorization to violate constraints; exact minimum needs a proof.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Minimum Environment Change
concepts.definition: Least-cost allowed change in environmental variables that enables task feasibility.
concepts.formalization: inf_δ cost(δ) s.t. ∃z∈F(E⊕δ), δ∈allowed interventions.
concepts.evaluator: Joint trajectory/environment optimization or counterfactual search.
concepts.required_inputs: Movable geometry, change bounds/cost, task and oracle.
concepts.limitations: A modified feasible scene does not prove the robot can enact the change.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Minimum Task Deformation
concepts.definition: Smallest permitted modification of reference trajectory or soft task specification yielding feasible execution.
concepts.formalization: inf_{δ∈D_allowed}||δ||_W s.t. F(T⊕δ)≠∅.
concepts.evaluator: Constrained deformation or path repair with verified witness.
concepts.required_inputs: Reference path/task, metric, allowed modifications, hard constraints.
concepts.limitations: Preserve mandatory goals and safety; local solution gives upper bound, not global minimum.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Mode Substitutability
concepts.definition: Existence of an alternate allowed mode or sequence satisfying the same task after excluding a mode.
concepts.formalization: ∃π∈Π_allowed excluding m with same goal and verified feasibility.
concepts.evaluator: Search alternative mode families under same task constraints.
concepts.required_inputs: Allowed and excluded modes, goals, costs and safety constraints.
concepts.limitations: Alternatives may differ in cost or robustness; validate the new execution.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Failure Attribution
concepts.definition: Evidence-supported identification of constraints, stages or assumptions explaining failure in a specified solution family.
concepts.formalization: Compare hypotheses using conflict certificates or controlled differences V(F_h)−V(F).
concepts.evaluator: Query bottlenecks, conflicts and interventions; rank scoped evidence and keep unknowns.
concepts.required_inputs: Failed family, alternative hypotheses, scope, oracle and budget.
concepts.limitations: No unique causal explanation guaranteed; counterfactual conclusions are model-relative.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Grasp–Wrench Compatibility
concepts.definition: Task-wide containment of required wrenches in the attainable grasp wrench set with consistent frames and sign conventions.
concepts.formalization: ∀s, W_required(s)⊆W_available(g,q(s),s).
concepts.evaluator: Construct contact wrench sets, test force feasibility or inclusion and margins.
concepts.required_inputs: Contacts, friction, mass/inertia, path and actuator force limits.
concepts.limitations: Force closure at one state does not guarantee bounded task-wide wrench capacity.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Kinodynamic Connectivity
concepts.definition: Existence of a state-control trajectory connecting endpoints under dynamics and state/input constraints.
concepts.formalization: ∃x(t),u(t),T: xdot=f(x,u), x(0)∈Xs, x(T)∈Xg, constraints hold.
concepts.evaluator: Kinodynamic planning, trajectory optimization or reachability with validation.
concepts.required_inputs: Dynamics, initial/goal state sets, controls, environment and limits.
concepts.limitations: Geometric path existence does not imply dynamic feasibility; sampling failure is not a certificate.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.

concepts.name: Contact-Mode Connectivity
concepts.definition: Existence of a physically admissible hybrid execution through contact modes and valid transitions.
concepts.formalization: ∃ mode sequence with continuous segments satisfying contact laws and valid guards/resets.
concepts.evaluator: Contact-mode graph, complementarity or hybrid optimization with checks.
concepts.required_inputs: Contact geometry/friction, modes, dynamic or quasistatic model.
concepts.limitations: Quasistatic results are not dynamic guarantees; switches require consistent states and forces.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Dynamic Bottleneck
concepts.definition: A task region restricting feasible executions through attainable force, torque, speed or controllability margins.
concepts.formalization: sup_{ξ∈Γ_dynamic}inf_t min_j normalized slack_j(ξ(t)).
concepts.evaluator: Evaluate dynamic constraints over candidate trajectory families; identify limiting interval.
concepts.required_inputs: Dynamics, actuator/contact limits, normalization and family.
concepts.limitations: A single trajectory peak torque is L3; L4 requires a family or certified bound.
concepts.source_relationship: Proposed HiCoD operational definition; cited literature supports the underlying theory or method, not necessarily the exact name or formula.

concepts.name: Temporal Feasibility
concepts.definition: Existence of an admissible time parameterization of a prescribed geometric path under dynamic and kinematic bounds.
concepts.formalization: ∃ monotone s(t): q(t)=q_path(s(t)) with velocity/acceleration/torque bounds and boundary conditions.
concepts.evaluator: TOPP-RA or equivalent path-speed controllability analysis with verification.
concepts.required_inputs: Geometric path, boundary velocities, limits and dynamics.
concepts.limitations: This concerns a prescribed path and modeled constraints, not search over all path shapes.
concepts.source_relationship: Established underlying concept; the formula is a scoped project specification, not a verbatim source definition.
